subject: Follow-up: SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA & telemetry/cookie questions — next steps
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Hendrix <sarah.hendrix@acmehealth.com>, Mike Russell <mike.russell@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA & telemetry/cookie questions — next steps

Hi Sarah / Mike —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking through Acme Health’s security requirements. Per our call, I wanted to recap the open items and proposed next steps so we can keep things moving toward a POC. TL;DR below, details and owners after.

TL;DR
- SOC 2 Type II: Redwood is currently completing a Type II; we have a timeline and limited interim artifacts we can share. (See attachment.)
- GDPR / HIPAA: We support both; Redwood can sign a DPA + BAA.
- Telemetry & cookies: Product console collects aggregated usage metrics and uses first-party session cookies; docs site runs analytics and shows cookie banner. No persistent 3rd-party trackers in the console.
- Vendor questionnaire: Attach your questionnaire — happy to start; asking security to own the detailed answers.

Open items / owners
1) SOC 2 artifacts — Jonas to share current timeline and interim report. Attachment: Redwood_Security_OnePager.pdf; SOC2-timeline-202610.pdf (high level).
2) Vendor security questionnaire — I’ve attached the ACME file you sent on the call and copied Priyom + Mina to coordinate completion. Proposed turnaround: 5 business days for initial pass.
3) Telemetry / PII + cookie specifics — short answers below, Mina will follow up with detailed technical notes if needed.

Quick answers on telemetry & cookies (high level)
- Data collection: By default the console collects anonymized, aggregated usage metrics (page views, API call counts, errors, latency percentiles).
- PII: We do not harvest customer PII as part of product telemetry. IPs are hashed and used transiently for rate-limit/abuse detection; raw IPs are not stored long-term (default retention 7 days).
- Cookies & third-party trackers: The customer-facing docs site uses Google Analytics and a cookie banner; the Redwood product console uses first-party session cookies (session auth token) and does not include third-party ad trackers.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We offer a DPA and standard BAA; data residency options available on Dedicated/Private deployments.

Next steps proposed
- Mina Haddad (security) to complete vendor questionnaire and provide technical notes by EOD next Thursday (2026-10-15).
- Jonas to provide SOC2 timeline doc (attached) and interim evidence where permissible.
- Schedule a short follow-up call with Acme security team if they want to walk through questionnaire answers.

Attachments:

[Attachment: SOC2-timeline-202610.pdf (PDF, 95KB)]
[Attachment: ACME_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (XLSX, 480KB) — original from Acme]

Thanks — I’ll stay on this and make sure we hit the 5-business-day target for the questionnaire.

Best,

Thanks Jonas — that recap is helpful. A few clarifying questions from our security and privacy team: 

1) SOC 2: can you confirm whether you currently have a Type I or Type II? Do you have any bridge letter or interim audit results you can share under NDA?
2) Telemetry / PII: our privacy team wants to confirm exact fields collected by the console telemetry (list of fields) and whether customers can opt-out at org or user level. Also please confirm retention windows for anything that could be considered personal data (IPs, user-agent).
3) Cookies & docs: we require vendor sites that market to our users to have an explicit cookie consent banner and a way to opt-out of analytics — does your docs site support that? If so, is it configurable per region (EU)?

We attached the vendor questionnaire again in the thread — we’d appreciate a completed pass and rationale for any ‘No / Partial’ answers. If possible, can your security lead produce an initial pass by Friday (10/16)? If that’s tight, EOD 10/15 would be ideal.

Thanks,

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA & telemetry/cookie questions — next steps

Sarah — thanks for the clear asks. Short answers here and Mina will follow with the questionnaire draft and technical notes.

SOC 2
- Status: Redwood is undergoing its first SOC 2 Type II audit; Type I completed in 2025. Expected Type II report issuance: target 2027-01-15.
- Interim artifacts: we can share our SOC 2 scope statement, Type I report (redacted), and current control matrix under NDA. See attached SOC2-timeline-202610.pdf for milestones.

Telemetry / PII
- Fields collected by default telemetry: event name, timestamp, feature flag state, anonymized org_id, anonymized user_hash, API route, response latency, error codes. We do NOT collect free-form user content or full request payloads for telemetry.
- IPs: used transiently for abuse detection; we hash and discard raw IPs within 7 days by default. Retention windows are configurable for Dedicated/Private customers.
- Opt-out: customers can opt their org out of product telemetry via the Account -> Data & Privacy toggle in the Console; we can also disable telemetry at a project level on Dedicated/Private.

Cookies & docs site
- Docs site: cookie consent banner present and supports EU consent mode; analytics can be disabled via the banner.
- Console: uses a first-party session cookie for auth and a small first-party cookie for UX preferences. No third-party advertising trackers run inside the console.

Vendor questionnaire / timeline
- Mina Haddad (copied) will take ownership of the ACME questionnaire and produce an initial draft of answers. Proposed internal deadline: EOD Thu 2026-10-15, which should let us deliver to you by Friday 10/16 if no major clarifications are needed.

I’ve attached the questionnaire you re-sent and a very short security one-pager for context. Mina, can you confirm you’re ok with the timeline? Priyom will help coordinate approvals if anything needs legal sign-off.

Regards,

Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
